conditions.text: C1 — An element with म् as इत् goes after the last vowel of what it is added to (as its final part); this overrides both स्थाने (1.1.49) and “परः” of suffixes.
C2 — Kāśikā examples: श्नम् (3.1.78 विरुणद्धि), नुम् (7.1.59 मुञ्चति, 7.1.72 पयांसि). Exception: for मस्ज् the नुम् is wanted before the last sound.
